(c) measures taken to control higher inflation to give relief to the common people;
(d) the reasons for higher food prices, especially in oil and fats categories, despite bumper
harvest in the country; and
(e) the efforts made to stabilize the economy, the details thereof?
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE  
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION 
(SHRI ASHWINI KUMAR CHOUBEY) 
(a) to (e). The Government monitors the retail and wholesale prices of 22 essential food commodities
submitted by the 179 price monitoring centres that have been set up with Central assistance by State
Governments and UT Administrations across the country. The All India retail prices of 22 essential
commodities fluctuated in last two year and current year. The detail is at Annexure.
Prices of essential food commodities are volatile and tend to get affected by several factors, such as 
mismatch in demand and supply, seasonality, supply chain constraints, artificial shortage created by 
hoarding and black marketing, rise in international prices etc. Sometimes slight disruptions in supply 
chain or damage due to heavy rains leads to spike in prices of agri-horticultural commodities. 
Taking into account price trends, the Government takes various measures from time to time to 
augment domestic availability and stabilize prices of essential food commodities. These steps, inter 
alia, include releases from the buffer to cool down prices, imposition of stock limits, monitoring of 
stocks declared by entities to prevent hoarding as also requisite changes in trade policy instruments like 
rationalization of import duty, changes in import quota, restrictions on exports of the commodity etc. 
251

 
 
  In May, 2021 advisories were issued to States/UTs to monitor prices of essential food 
commodities and to ensure disclosure of pulses stocks held by millers, importers and traders under the 
Essential Commodities Act, 1955. Imposition of stock limit on all pulses except Moong was notified on 
2.7.21. Thereafter, an amended order was issued on 19.7.21 imposing stock limits on four pulses, 
namely, Tur,Urad, Masur, Chana for a period up to 31.10.2021. 
  To improve availability and stabilise prices of pulses, the Government had allowed import of 
Tur, Urad and Moong under ‘Free category’ w.e.f 15.5.2021 till 31.10.2021 in order to ensure smooth 
and seamless imports. The Free regime was thereafter extended in respect of Tur and Urad till 
31.3.2022. This policy measure has been supported with facilitation measures and close monitoring of 
its implementation by the concerned Departments/organisations. The import policy measures have 
resulted in substantial increase in import of Tur, Urad and Moong as compared to the corresponding 
period for the past two years. In order to soften the impact of higher international prices on domestic 
consumers, the Government reduced duty on Masur to zero till September 30, 2022 and waived off the 
penalty on pulses import consignments from methyl bromide phased out countries for not being 
fumigated with methyl bromide in the country of origin till June 30, 2024. To augment the availability 
of pulses in the market, 3 Lakh Metric Ton of Chana stock has been released between June and August, 
20
21 through open market sales and to stabilise prices, futures trading in Chana has been suspended 
from August 16, 2021. State Governments have been supplied pulses from the buffer stock on an 
ongoing basis for their nutrition and welfare programmes.  
  In order to stabilise retail prices of onion, a buffer stock of 2.08 LMT had been built in 2021-22. 
Open market releases of onion from the buffer were targeted towards States/Cities where prices were 
increasing.
 Releases were also made in source markets to augment the availability in key mandis and 
thereby reduce retail prices. States/UTs had also been offered onion at Rs.21/kg ex-storage locations. 
  In order to improve the domestic availability of edible oils and to keep prices under control, the 
Government has rationalized the duty structure on edible oils by reducing the effective duties. As per

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 2643 
TO BE ANSWERED ON: 25.03.2022 
 
 
ANNUAL DEMAND OF SEMICONDUCTORS  
  
2643. SHRI MAHESH PODDAR:        
 
Will the Minister of ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to 
state: 
 
(a) the annual demand of semiconductors in the country and how much of this is met from 
imports in the last three years, the details thereof; 
 
(b) the sectors which are primary consumers of semiconductors and whether any losses were 
incurred from chip shortage that was faced globally, if so, the details thereof; and  
 
(c) the incentives being given to foreign firms to set up a base in India for electronic productions, 
the details thereof? 
 
 
 ANSWER 
  
MINISTER OF STATE FOR ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY (SHRI 
RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a): The government is very focused on its important objective of building the overall 
semiconductor ecosystem and ensure that, it in- turn catalyses India‟s rapidly expanding 
electronics manufacturing and innovation ecosystem. As a result of several initiatives taken by 
the Government and efforts of the industry, the domestic production of electronic products has 
increased substantially from ₹ 2,43,263 crore (USD 37 billion) in 2015 -16 to ₹ 5,54,461 crore 
(USD 74.7 billion) in 2020-21 growing at a Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of 17.9%. 
Many policies of the Government including the flagship Production Linked Incentive (PLI) 
Schemes, Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and 
Semiconductors, Modified Electronics Manufacturing Cluster (EMC 2.0) Scheme are major 
steps towards making India „AtmaNirbhar‟ in electronics manufacturing.  
 
As semiconductors form a major part of all electronic products, as a result of growth in 
electronicsmanufacturing sector, semiconductor market in India has also witnessed  
proportionate growth over the last few years. 
As per the industry estimate, the semiconductor 
consumption in India was around INR 1.1 lakh crore in year 2020 which is being met through 
imports due to absence of commercial semiconductor fabs in India. 
 
258

(b):  The semiconductor chip shortage has impacted many industries worldwide with auto and  
electronics industries among the most affected sectors. The shortage first emerged after the 
Covid-19 pandemic, due to lockdowns and restrictions. The supply side problem has transformed 
into a demand side problem as economies started recovering which increased the consumption of 
electronic products across various segments. Some key reasons behind the global chip shortage 
are supply chain disruptions, geographic concentration of electronic manufacturing, rise in 
demand for digital and electronic products and digital adoption across the world. 
 
 
 
 
Semiconductors are essential to virtually all sectors of the economy- including aerospace, 
automobiles, communications, clean energy, information technology and medical devices. 
Demand for these critical components has outstripped supply, creating a global chip shortage and 
resulting in lost growth and jobs in the economy. The shortage has exposed vulnerabilities in the 
semiconductor supply chain and highlighted the need for increased domestic manufacturing 
capacity. 
 
Semicon India programme is expected to surely play a role in India‟s semiconductor chips and 
display requirements in the medium and long term. The programme has broader objectives of 
ensuring a globally competitive value chain that is based in India but supplies electronics 
products, semiconductors and technology services and solutions to the world.  
 
(c): The vision of AtmaNirbhar Bharat in electronics & semiconductors was given further 
momentum by the Union Cabinet, chaired by the Hon‟ble Prime Minister, approving the 
Semicon India programme with a total outlay of INR 76,000 crore for the development of 
semiconductor and display manufacturing ecosystem in our country. The programme aims to 
provide financial support to companies investing in semiconductors, display manufacturing and 
design ecosystem. This will serve to pave the way for India‟s growing presence in the global 
electronics value chains. 
 
Following four schemes have been introduced under the aforesaid programme:  
 
i. Scheme for setting up of Semiconductor Fabs in India  
provides fiscal support to 
eligible applicants for setting up of Semiconductor Fabs which is aimed at attracting large 
investments for setting up semiconductor wafer fabrication facilities in the country. 
Following fiscal support has been approved under the scheme:  
 

 28nm or Lower - Up to 50% of the Project Cost 
 Above 28 nm to 45nm - Up to 40% of the Project Cost 
 Above 45 nm to 65nm - Up to 30% of the Project Cost 
 
ii. Scheme for setting up of Display Fabs in India provides fiscal support to eligible 
applicants for setting up of Display Fabs which is aimed at attracting large investments 
for setting up TFT LCD / AMOLED based display fabrication facilities in the country. 
259

The Scheme provides fiscal support of up to 50% of Project Cost subject to a ceiling of 
INR 12,000 crore per Fab. 
 
iii. Scheme for setting up of Compound Semiconductors / Silicon Photonics / Sensors 
Fab and Semiconductor Assembly, Testing, Marking and Packaging (ATMP) / 
OSAT facilities in India: The Scheme provides a fiscal support of 30% of the Capital 
Expenditure to the eligible applicants for setting up of Compound Semiconductors / 
Silicon Photonics (SiPh) / Sensors (including MEMS) Fab and Semiconductor ATMP / 
OSAT facilities in India.  
 
iv. Design Linked Incentive (DLI) Scheme 
offers financial incentives, design infrastructure 
support across various stages of development and deployment of semiconductor design 
for Integrated Circuits (ICs), Chipsets, System on Chips (SoCs), Systems & IP Cores and 
semiconductor linked design. The scheme provides “Product Design Linked Incentive” of 
up to 50% of the eligible expenditure subject to a ceiling of ₹15 Crore per application and 
“Deployment Linked Incentive” of 6% to 4% of net sales turnover over 5 years subject to 
a ceiling of ₹30 Crore per application. 
 
 
 
 
In addition to the above schemes, Government has also approved modernisation of Semi-
Conductor Laboratory, Mohali 
as a brownfield Fab. 
 
Other steps taken by the Government for making the country self reliant in electronics 
manufacturing are as follows: 
 
1.
 National Policy on Electronics 2019:  The National Policy on Electronics 2019 (NPE 
2019) has been notified on 25.02.2019. The vision of NPE 2019 is to position India as a 
global hub for Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) by encouraging 
and driving capabilities in the country for developing core components, including 
chipsets, and creating an enabling environment for the industry to compete globally. 
 
2.
 100% FDI:  As per extant Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) policy, FDI up-to 100% 
under the automatic route is permitted for electronics manufacturing (except from 
countries sharing land border with India), subject to applicable laws / regulations; 
security and other conditions. 
 
3.
 Electronics Manufacturing Clusters (EMC) Scheme:  Electronics Manufacturing 
Clusters Scheme was notified on 22nd October, 2012 to provide support for creation of 
world-class infrastructure along with common facilities and amenities for attracting 
investment. Under the Scheme, 19 Greenfield EMCs and 3 Common Facility Centres 
(CFCs) measuring an area of 3,464 acres with total project cost of INR 3,762 crore 
including Government Grant-in-Aid of INR 1,538 crore have been approved. 
 
260

4. Electronics Development Fund (EDF):  Electronics Development Fund (EDF) has been 
set up as a “Fund of Funds” to participate in professionally managed “Daughter Funds” 
which in turn will provide risk capital to startups and companies developing new 
technologies in the area of electronics and Information Technology (IT). This fund is 
expected to foster R&D and innovation in these technology sectors. INR 319 crore has 
been committed through EDF to 8 Daughter Funds with a targeted corpus of INR 2,176 
crore. 
 
5.
 Phased Manufacturing Programme (PMP)  has been notified to promote domestic 
value addition in mobile phones and their sub-assemblies / parts manufacturing. As a 
result, India has rapidly started attracting investments into this sector and significant 
manufacturing capacities have been set up in the country. The manufacturing of mobile 
phones has been steadily moving from Semi Knocked Down (SKD) to Completely 
Knocked Down (CKD) level, thereby progressively increasing the domestic value 
addition. 
 
 
6. Tariff Structure has been rationalized  to promote domestic manufacturing of 
electronic products, including, inter-alia, Cellular mobile phones, Televisions, Electronic 
components, Set Top Boxes for TV, LED products and Medical electronics equipment. 
 
7.
 Exemption from Basic Customs Duty on capital products:  Notified capital p roducts 
for manufacture of specified electronic products are permitted for import at “NIL” Basic 
Customs Duty. 
 
8.
 Simplified import of used plant and machinery:  The import of used plant and 
machinery having a residual life of at least 5 years for use by the electronics 
manufacturing industry has been simplified through the amendment of Hazardous and 
Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016, vide Ministry 
of Environment, Forest and Climate Change Notification dated 11.06.2018. 
 
9.
 Relaxing the ageing restriction:  The Department of Revenue vide Notification 
No.60/2018-Customs dated 11.09.2018 has amended the Notification No.158/95-
Customs dated 14.11.1995, relaxing the ageing restriction from 3 years to 7 years for 
specified electronic goods manufactured in India and re-imported into India for repairs or 
reconditioning. 
 
10. Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017:  
To encourage „Make 
in India‟ and to promote manufacturing and production of goods and services in India 
with a view to enhancing income and employment, the Government has issued Public 
Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017 vide the Department for 
Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) Order dated 15.06.2017 and 
subsequent revisions vide Orders dated 28.05.2018, 29.05.2019, 04.06.2020 and 
16.09.2020. In furtherance of the aforesaid Order, MeitY has notified mechanism for 
calculating local content for 13 Electronic Products viz., (i) Desktop PCs, (ii) Thin 
Clients, (iii) Computer Monitors, (iv) Laptop PCs, (v) Tablet PCs, (vi) Dot Matrix 
Printers, (vii) Contact and Contactless Smart Cards, (viii) LED Products, (ix) Biometric 
261

Access Control / Authentication Devices, (x) Biometric Finger Print Sensors, (xi) 
Biometric Iris Sensors, (xii) Servers, and (xiii) Cellular Mobile Phones, for procurement 
to be made from local suppliers. 
 
11. Compulsory Registration Order (CRO):  
MeitY has notified “Electronics and 
Information Technology Products (Requirement of Compulsory Registration) Order, 
2012” for mandatory compliance to ensure safety of Indian citizens by curbing import of 
substandard and unsafe electronic goods into India. 63 Product Categories have been 
notified under the CRO and the order is applicable on 63 product categories. 
 
12. Establishment of Gallium Nitride (GaN) Ecosystem Enabling Centre and 
Incubator:
 The project for “Establishment of Gallium Nitride (GaN) Ecosystem 
Enabling Centre and Incubator for High Power and High Frequency Ele ctronics” has 
been approved. The project is being implemented by Society for Innovation and 
Development (SID), Centre for Nano Science and Engineering (CeNSE), IISc 
Bengaluru.

2646 SHRI SUJEET KUMAR: 
 
Will the Minister of ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
  
 
(a) whether more than 11.5 lakh incidents of cyber attacks were tracked and reported to India’s 
Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) in 2021;  
 
(b) whether power companies, oil and gas majors, telecom vendors, restaurant chains and even 
diagnostic labs have been the victims of cyber attacks;  
 
(c) the steps that have been taken by the Ministry to prevent cyber security incidents and keep 
cyber space free from such nuisance; and  
 
(d) whether Government has taken any steps to update its current cyber security framework 
amidst growing reports of cyber attacks in the country? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a): The Government is committed to ensure that the Internet in India is Open, Safe & Trusted and 
Accountable for all users. 
 
Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) is mandated to track and monitor cyber 
security incidents in India. CERT-In has reported that a total number of 14 ,
02,809 cyber security 
incidents are observed during the year 2021. 
 
(b): As per CERT-In, cyber security incidents are observed across various sectors such as E-
Commerce, Energy, Finance, Government, Healthcare, Information Technology, Manufacturing, 
Telecom, Transportation etc.   
 
(c): Government is fully cognizant and aware of various cyber security threats; and has taken the 
following measures to enhance the cyber security posture and prevent cyber security incidents : 
 
268

i. The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) issues alerts and advisories 
regarding latest cyber threats/vulnerabilities and countermeasures to protect computers and 
networks on regular basis.   
 
ii. CERT-In operates an automated cyber threat exchange platform for proactively collection, 
analysis and sharing of tailored alerts with organisations across sectors for proactive threat 
mitigation actions by them. 
 
iii. Government has issued guidelines for Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs) 
regarding their key roles and responsibilities for securing applications / infrastructure and 
compliance.  
 
iv. All the government websites and applications are audited with respect to cyber security prior 
to their hosting.  The auditing of the websites and applications is conducted on a regular 
basis after hosting also.

2650   SHRI PARIMAL NATHWANI: 
 
Will the Minister of ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to 
state: 
 
(a) whether the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) has developed a 
Digital Forensic Kiosk recently; and 
 
(b) if so, the details of benefits thereof and the sectors where this can be used?

MINISTER OF STATE FOR ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY (SHRI 
RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a) and (b): Yes, Sir. Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) has 
developed Digital Forensic Kiosk (DFK), which is a stand-alone forensic hardware platform for 
quick preview of evidential artefacts present in electronic exhibits such as Smart Phones, SIM 
Cards, Memory Cards, Hard Disks and other USB storage devices. 
 
Law Enforcement Agencies like National Investigation Agency 
(NIA), Intelligence Bureau (IB),

Agencies (LEA) is required.

shall enable the LEA to ascertain whether the suspected piece of evidence is available in the 
device or not and thereby unnecessary seizure of the device can be avoided.

Making India a blue economy 
 
2656.  Shri K.J. Alphons: 
 
      Will the Minister of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the status of execution of the plans for making India a leading blue economy; and 
 
(b)  the impact of the implementation of various schemes in the sector? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRYAND DAIRYING 
 
 
(SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA) 
 
(a) & (b): India’s blue economy is understood as a subset of the national economy comprising an entire ocean 
resources system and human-made economic infrastructure in marine, maritime, and onshore coastal zones 
within the country’s legal jurisdiction. The Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES) being the nodal Ministry, has 
rolled out the draft National Policy for India’s Blue Economy -2021. The policy document aims to enhance 
contribution of the blue economy to India’s GDP, improve lives of coastal communities, preserve ma rine 
biodiversity, and maintain the national security of marine areas and resources. The draft policy framework 
emphasizes policies across several key sectors including Fisheries to achieve holistic growth of India’s 
economy. 
 
The Government of India in recent years has taken several initiatives to harness the full potential of the 
fisheries sector in a sustainable and responsible manner. The Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS) –
 ‘Blue 
Revolution: Integrated Development and Management of Fisheries’ was launched in 2015-16 with an outlay of 
Rs 3000 crores for a period of 5 years. In order to address the critical gaps in the fisheries infrastructure, 
‘Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development Fund ’ (FIDF) was created in 2018-19 with a fund size 
of Rs. 7522.48 crores for providing concessional finance to the State/UT Governments, their entities and the 
private sector. Recognizing the immense potential in fisheries sector, the Government of India in May, 2020 
with highest investment of Rs. 20,050 crore, launched a new flagship scheme ‘Pradhan Mantri Matsya 
Sampada Yojana’ (PMMSY) to bring about Blue Revolution through sustainable and responsible development 
of fisheries sector in the country. PMMSY is being implemented for a period of five years from 2020-21 to 
2024-25 in all States and UTs. As a result of these initiatives, during the recent years the Fisheries sector in 
India has shown impressive growth with an average annual growth rate of about 10 % (during 2014-15 to 
2018-19), the fish production has registered an average annual growth of more than 7% and stood at an all-
time high of 141.64 lakh metric tons during 2019-20. Despite various issues faced by the sector during Covid -
19 pandemic, India has achieved all time high exports of marine products worth US$ 7165 million during April 
to February, 2021-22.

during the lean period of fishing related work; 
(c)  whether there is any scheme to help the fishing communities to engage in modern fish 
farming by training them in this area; and

      THE MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING

) to (d):  The Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying

 inter-alia provides

families during the fishing ban/lean period under which  Governmental financial assistance  of

contribution of Rs. 1500 /- annually.  Further, such accumulated amount of Rs. 4500/ - is

carried out through the National Fisheries Development Board, ICAR institutes, Krishi Vigyan

25 based on One District One Product (ODOP) approach, with an outlay of ₹ 10,000 crore; 
 
(b) if so, the details thereof, if not, the reasons therefor; and 
 
(c) the details of the progress State-wise and year-wise especially for the State of West Bengal? 
  
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
  
(a): Yes Sir.  
  
(b): Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) is implementing a centrally sponsored "PM 
Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme" for providing financial, 
technical and business support for upgradation of micro food processing enterprises in the country. 
The scheme is operational for a period of five years from 2020-21 to 2024-25 with an outlay of Rs 
10,000 Crore. 
  
The Scheme adopts One District One Product (ODOP) approach to reap the benefit of scale 
in terms of procurement of inputs, availing common services and marketing of products. ODOP 
for the scheme provides the framework f or value chain development and alignment of support 
infrastructure. 
 
  The scheme envisages following support to Individual Micro Enterprises, Farmer Producer 
Organizations (FPOs)/ Self Help Groups (SHGs)/ Producer Cooperatives:  
 
i. Support to Individual Mic ro Enterprises:  Credit-linked capital subsidy @35% of the 
eligible project cost, maximum ceiling Rs.10 lakh per unit; 
 
ii. Support to FPOs/ SHGs/ Producer Cooperatives: Credit linked Grant @35% to support 
clusters and groups such as FPOs/ SHGs/ Producer Cooper atives along their entire value chain 
for sorting, grading, storage, common processing, packaging, marketing, testing etc.  
 
iii. Support to SHGs for seed capital:  Seed capital @ Rs. 40,000/ - per member of SHG 
engaged in food processing for working capital and purchase of small tools. 
  
iv. Support for Common Infrastructure: Credit linked grant @ 35% to support FPOs, SHGs, 
Cooperatives, any Government agency or private enterprises for Common infrastructure. The 
300

 
common infrastructure will also be available for other units and public to utilize on hiring basis 
for substantial part of the capacity. 
  
v. Branding and Marketing Support: Grant upto 50% for Branding and Marketing to groups 
of FPOs/ SHGs/ Cooperatives or an SPV of micro food processing enterprises. 
  
vi. Capacity Building: The scheme envisages training for Entrepreneurship Development 
Skilling (EDP+): program modified to meet the requirement of food processing industry and 
product specific skilling.  
  
 (c):  The State of West Bengal is yet to decide on implementation of the PMFME Scheme. The 
statements indicating the State wise funds released, number of projects approved, number of 
persons trained etc. under various components of PMFME Scheme is at Annexure.

2669. SHRI SATISH CHANDRA DUBEY:

(a) whether the Government has identified the fruits and vegetables which get spoilt early to 
set up small food processing units at agricultural land level or village level; 
 
(b) if so, the State-wise and district-wise details thereof; and 
 
(c) The State-wise details of funds allocated, disbursed and utilized for this purpose during 
the year 2021-22 till date? 
      
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
 
(a) & (b) : Yes Sir, 22 perishable crops as detailed below, have been identified for assistance 
under long term measures of Operation Greens Scheme. 
 
Fruits (10):  Mango, Banana, Apple, Pineapple, Orange, Grapes, Aonla/Amla, Pomegranate,

[Bottle Gourd (Loki), Bitter Gourd (Karela), Ridge/Sponge Gourd (Torai), Pointed Gourd 
(Parwal) and Ash Gourd (Petha)], Okra, Garlic, Ginger. 
 
Marine (1): Shrimp

production data provided by Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare.

the scheme. During the year 2021 -22, total expenditure of Rs. 5.78 crore has been incurred  till

Rs.5.78 crore, Rs.4.32 crore has been released as Grant -in-aid for the projects sanct ioned in the

GROWTH OF FPIs 
 
2670. SHRI T.G. VENKATESH: 
          
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether the growth of Food Processing Industries (FPI) in the country is satisfactory, if so, the 
details thereof; 
(b) the role of Government in the growth of FPIs; 
(c) the details of the items that make major contribution to the FPIs; and 
(d) the status of the FPI growth in the State of Andhra Pradesh?  
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
 
(a): The Gross Value Addition (GVA) in food processing sector has increased from Rs. 1.34 lakh crore 
in 2014-15 to Rs. 2.24 lakh crore in 2019-20 at a Compounded Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of 10.82 %.  
 
(b): The Ministry of Food Processing Industries contributes to the growth of food processing industries 
by implementing various schemes l ike Pradhan Mantri Kisan Sampada Yojana (PMKSY), which is a 
comprehensive programme for overall growth and development of the food processing sector through 
creation of modern post-harvest infrastructure and value-addition. The Ministry is also implementing two 
new schemes as part of the Aatmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan:  
 
(i). PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme (PM FME) with the aim to provide 
financial, technical and business support for upgradation/ setting up of two lakh micro food processing 
units on One District One Product (ODOP) approach.  
 
(ii). Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme for boosting manufacturing competitiveness and exports 
and for creating global food manufacturing champions. 
 
(c): The following processed food items contributed to value addition in food processing sector during 
2019-20 includes (i) manufacture of bakery products, sugar & sugar confectionery, chocolate & cocoa 
products, prepared meals & dishes, processing & blending of tea & coffee, edible nuts, malted foods, 
processing of spices etc. (ii) milling of rice, flour, pulses, cereal breakfast foods, readymade mixed 
powders, (iii) production, processing and preservation of meat, fish, fruit, vegetables, oils and fats, (iv) 
manufacture of soft drinks and alcoholic beverages and (v) manufacture of dairy products. 
 
(d): As per the Annual Survey of Industries released by Ministry of Statistics and Programme 
Implementation, the gross value added in Andhra Pradesh has grown from Rs. 7,02,435 lakh in 2014 -15 
to Rs. 10,20,784 lakh in 2018-19 at a Compounded Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of 9.79 %.

SCHEME TO PROCESS FARMER'S PRODUCE 
 
 
2671. MS. SAROJ PANDEY: 
 
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
 
 
(a) whether Government has formulated any scheme to process and sell the  products of 
farmers in their own village or area of residence; and 
 
(b) if so, the outline of the said scheme, if not, whether Government would propose  to 
formulate any such scheme? 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
  
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
  
 
(a) & (b):  Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) is implementing a Central Sector 
umbrella scheme- Pradhan Mantri Kisan Sampada Yojana (PMKSY) since 2016-17. Under its 
component schemes, it, inter alia, provides grants -in-aid for setting up of food processing/ 
preservation industries with farm level infrastructure like primary processing facilities, 
collection centers etc. MoFPI is also implementing a centrally sponsored "PM Formalisation of 
Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme" for a period of five years from 2020-21 
to 2024-25 with an outlay of Rs 10,000 Crore. PMFME Scheme provides support to Self Help 
Groups (SHGs)/ Farmer  Producer Organizations (FPOs)/ Cooperatives for setting up/ 
upgradation of micro food processing units, Seed Capital to SHGs, Common Infrastructure, 
Marketing & Branding support etc. These schemes help farmers in processing/ selling their 
produce in farm vicinity.

2672. Ms. INDU BALA GOSWAMI: 
 
Will the Minister of Heavy Industries be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government has allowed the States to formulate their own policy for 
promotion of electric vehicles; 
 
(b) if so, the details thereof; 
 
(c) whether Government is formulating any scheme for manufacturing of Lithium 
batteries in the country which is essential for electric vehicles; and 
 
(d) if so, the details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR HEAVY INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI KRISHAN PAL GURJAR) 
 
(a) & (b): Yes Sir, Seventeen states (Andhra Pradesh, Delhi, Karnataka, Kerala, 
Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Odisha, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Meghalaya, 
Gujarat, Assam, Goa, Rajasthan, West Bengal and Uttarakhand) have approved/notified /

in tandem to supplement the steps taken by the 
Government for faster adoption of EVs. 
 
(c) & (d): The Government on 12 th May, 2021 approved PLI Scheme for manufacturing 
of Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) in the country with a budgetary outlay of Rs. 18,100 
crore.  The scheme envisages to establish a competitive ACC battery manufacturing set up in 
the country for 50 GWh.  Additionally, 5GWh of niche ACC technologies is also covered 
under the Scheme.
  The program is technology agnostic in nature and currently, the

 SHRI SYED ZAFAR ISLAM: 
 
Will the Minister of Heavy Industries be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the objectives sought to be achieved under phase-II of FAME India scheme and 
National Auto Policy; 
 
(b) whether any charging station for electric vehicles has been set up in the country, 
including Uttar Pradesh and if so, the details thereof; 
 
(c) whether it is a fact that currently, private companies cannot set up „charging stations‟ 
in India, as sale of electricity is a licensed activity and if so, the details thereof; and 
 
(d) the 
efforts made by Government to promote setting up of charging stations for electric 
vehicles in the country?

THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR HEAVY INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI KRISHAN PAL GURJAR) 
 
(a): The Phase-II of Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of (Hybrid &) Electric Vehicles 
in India (FAME India) proposes to give a push to electric vehicles (EVs) in public transport 
and encourage adoption of EVs by way of market creation and demand aggregation.  The 
scheme envisaged the holistic growth of EV industry including providing charging 
infrastructure and push towards greater Indigenization.  FAME-II aims to support through 
subsidies, 7090 e-Buses, 5 lakh e-3 Wheelers, 55000 e-4 Wheeler Passenger Cars and 10 lakh 
e-2 Wheelers.  Further, a draft National Automotive Policy has been prepared by MHI and 
placed on the website of MHI (

nature and addresses the interests of the Automotive Industry in meeting the objectives of the 
Auto Mission Plan 2016-26.

 Further, as per information received from the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas,

2675: SHRI ELAMARAM KAREEM: 
 
Will the Minister of Heavy Industries be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the present status of transfer of Instrumentation Limited, Palakkad to Kerala 
Government; 
 
(b) the reasons for delay in completing the transfer process even after providing in-
principle 
approval years ago; 
 
(c) how 
much is the present value of the assets in possession of this plant; and 
 
(d) whether the Central Government is backfooting from its commitment of transfering 
this 
plant to Kerala Government, if so, the reasons therefor, if not, by when this process would 
be completed? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR HEAVY INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI KRISHAN PAL GURJAR) 
 
(a) to (d): The Union Cabinet had approved on 30.11.2016 the closure of the Kota Unit of 
Instrumentation Limited and accorded ‘in principle’ approval for the transfer of Palakkad Unit 
of Instrumentation Limited to the Government of Kerala (GoK).  The GoK constituted a High 
Level Committee headed by the Chief Secretary of the GoK to work out the modalities of the 
transfer, Ministry of Heavy Industries was represented on the Committee.  Based on its 
deliberations, a tripartite Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed by Government 
of India, Ministry of Heavy Industries (MHI), Government of Kerala, Department of Industry 
and Instrumentation Limited on 16.11.2018 defining the modalities of transfer of Pallakad 
Unit to the Government of Kerala as a ‘going concern’ with the approval of the competent 
authority. 
 
After signing of the MoU, while the required assessment of Net Asset Value (NAV) of 
the Pallakad Unit was underway, it was learnt that the High Level Committee had not taken 
into consideration the value of land owned by Pallakad Unit, measuring 566.30 acres which 
was assigned on registry to Instrumentation Limited, Kota for the establishment of Precision 
Instrumentation Project at Pudussery Kerala under the Rules of Assignment of Government 
Land for Industrial Purposes dated 30.03.1964, which has material bearing on the transfer 
modalities. The value of this land owned by Instrumentation Limited has not yet been 
assessed.

 the government encourages investment in the automobile sector however, the

country.  The total outlay

a competitive ACC battery manufacturing set up in the country (50 GWh).  Additionally, 
5GWh of niche ACC technologies is also covered under the Scheme.
  The scheme proposes a

addition achieved on actual sales made by the manufacturers

Proposal (RFP) inviting bids from domestic and international players for setting up 
manufacturing facilities for Advance Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage under this

amendments in the regulations regarding Technical Standards pertaining to Grid Connectivity

curiosity and transform the same into demand, discredit misinformation against Electric 
Vehicles and bring together multiple 
stakeholders under single platform.

(a) to (c) Yes, Sir. Ministry has formulated various schemes viz. Model, Modern and Adarsh 
Station Scheme for upgradation/beautification/ modernization of stations on Indian Railways. 
 
          ‘Model’ station scheme was in vogue from 1999 to 2008.  Initially one station per 
Division of Indian Railways was selected under the scheme.  In the year 2006, the criteria were 
revised to include all ‘A’ and ‘B’ category stations on the basis of the annual passenger 
earnings under the scheme.  Under this scheme 594 stations were selected for upgradation. Out 
of these, 590 stations have already been developed.  As regards, the remaining 4 stations, 
Sambalpur Road Station & Alnavar station ha ve been dropped from the scheme, while 
Ultadanga and Mal Bazar Stations have been closed. The names of stations developed under 
‘Model’ Station Scheme are at 
Appendix-I. 
 
       ‘Modern’ station scheme was in vogue from 2006-07 to 2007-08.  Under this scheme, 637 
stations were selected for upgradation which have already been developed. The names of 
stations developed under ‘Modern’ Station Scheme are at 
Appendix-II. 
 
          Presently, Railway stations are upgraded/modernized under ‘Adarsh’ Station Scheme 
based on identified need of providing better enhanced passenger amenities at stations. Under 
‘Adarsh’ Station Scheme , 1253 stations have been identified for development, out of which 
1213 stations so far have been developed and the remaining stations are targeted to be 
developed under Adarsh Station Scheme by Financial Year 2022-23 The names of stations 
identified for development under ‘Adarsh’ Station Scheme are at 
Appendix-III. 
 
 Various passenger amenities which, inter-alia, include improvement to façade of the 
station building, retiring room, waiting room (with bathing facilities), separate waiting room 
for ladies, landscaping of circulating area, earmarked parking, signages, Pay & Use toilets, 
Foot Over Bridge, ramps at entry to station etc. have been provided at these Railway stations as 
per the respective category of the station depending upon need, volume of passenger traffic and 
inter-se priority, subject to availability of funds. 
 
 Recently, a new umbrella work scheme of ‘Major Upgradation of Railway Station’ has been 
initiated. The facilities envisaged in this scheme includes rebuilding/improvement/augmentation of 
station building, congestion free non-conflicting entry/exit to the station premises, segregation of 
arrival/departure of passengers, adequate concourse without overcrowding, integration of both sides 
of the city wherever feasible, user friendly signages, well illuminated circulating area and sufficient 
provision for drop off, pick up & parking etc., and all facilities of Divyangjans among other 
facilities as per requirement and feasibility. So far, under this scheme, the work of major 
upgradation of Bijwasan station has been sanctioned. 
           
 Besides this, upgradation/beautification/ modernization/ soft upgradation of stations on 
Indian Railways is a continuous and on-going process and works in this regard are undertaken 
as per requirement, subject to inter-se priority and availability of funds. However, priority for 
upgradation/modernization of stations is accorded to higher category of station over lower 
category of station while sanctioning and executing the work.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
 
 
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.2691 
ANSWERED ON 25.03.2022 
 
 
RAILWAY CONCESSIONS AND CHARGES 
 
 
  
2691. DR. V. SIVADASAN: 
 
        Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Railways have reinstated the different concessions to the citizens which were stopped 
during COVID; 
 
(b)   if not, the reasons therefor; 
 
(c)  whether the availability of facilities in Rajadhani, Duronto and other AC trains have been 
reinstated; 
 
(d)  if not, whether Government intends to reduce the charges of services which are not provided 
to the passengers; and 
 
(e)   if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
 
 
   
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND ELECTRONICS & 
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
 
 
                                         (SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW) 
 
 
(a) & (b):  In view of Pandemic & Covid Protocol, with effect from 20.03.2020 Indian Railways 
has continued concession to only four categories of Divyangjan, eleven categories of Patients and 
Students. Due to challenges posed by Covid-19, total passenger revenue generated during 2020- 21 
is less in comparison to the year 2019-2020 Pre-Covid period. Cost of granting concessions weigh 
heavily on Railways, hence extending the scope of concessions to all categories of passengers is 
not desirable at present.  
           In spite of above challenges, Railways has continued to provide concessions to passengers 
namely four categories of Divyangjans, eleven categories of Patients, and Students.

QUESTION NO. 2701 BY SHRI TIRUCHI SIVA ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 
25.03.2022 REGARDING STEPS FOR ANIMAL SAFETY NEAR RAILWAY TRACKS  
 
(a) A number of preventive measures have been taken by Zonal Railways to reduce animal 
fatalities on Railway track, which include the following:  
(i) Cleaning of garbage and removal of wild vegetation along the track.  
(ii) Sensitization of Train Crew on a regular basis for frequent whistling at locations prone for 
cattle/animal run over.  
(iii) Construction of fencing/boundary wall at identified locations of trespass by cattle/animal 
and approaches of major towns.  
(iv) Counselling of villagers for taking necessary steps to avoid cattle coming near track 
through safety seminar/propagandas in villages.  
(v) Avoid dumping of food waste along railway track to avoid unnecessary congregation  of 
animals near railway track.  
 
(b) No, Sir. 
 
(c) The desired information regarding number of animal deaths on railway tracks in the last 
five years covering 16 Zonal Railways is quite spread out & extensive and requires sufficient 
time for compilation.   
 
(d) Yes, Sir.  
 
(e) A number of steps have been taken on railway lines running through forest areas, which 
include the following: 
(i) Imposition of suitable speed restrictions in identified vulnerable locations. 
(ii) Providing signage boards at suitable points to alert train drivers about elephant & other 
animal presence.  
(iii) Provision of fencing at isolated locations. 
(iv) Installation of innovative Honey bee sound systems at locations, which are prone to 
crossing of elephants.  
(v) Construction of underpasses and ramps for the movement of wild life at identified 
locations in consultation with Forest officials of the area. 
(vi) Forest Department staff deputed in Railway control offices to liaison with Railway  and 
elephant trackers engaged by Forest Department for timely action by alerting station master 
and loco pilots.

especially in the South Region and Karnataka and the cost of setting up of each centre during the last   
three years;  
 
(b) whether Government is implementing any scheme for incubation in apparel manufacturing, if so,   
the details thereof; and  
 
(c) the other steps taken to promote apparel manufacturing and its export in the country?  
 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR TEXTILES  
(SMT. DARSHANA JARDOSH) 
 
(a): With an objective to provide financial assistance to group of entrepreneurs to establish          
state–of-art infrastructure facilities in a cluster for setting up their textile units, Ministry has been 
implementing Scheme for Integrated Textile Park (SITP). The scheme has provisions to support setting 
up units of textile value chain viz. spinning, weaving, processing and garmenting etc. Under SITP,   
1947 units are operational across the country. Out of 1947 units, 454 units are operational in South 
Region, of which 42 units are operational in the State of Karnataka.  
 
(b): In order to create an integrated workspace and linkages based entrepreneurial ecosystem for     
(i) promoting entrepreneurship in apparel manufacturing; (ii) creating additional manufacturing; 
       
(iii) generating additional employment opportunities; Scheme for Incubation in Apparel Manufacturing 
(SIAM) was launched during the 12 th Five Year Plan.  During this period three project were approved 
viz.  
1.  Incubation Centre in Gwalior;  
2.  Incubation Centre in Apparel Manufacturing at Bhubaneshwar   
3.  Incubation Centre in Apparel Manufacturing at Panipat.   
 
 
 
419

 
(c): Steps taken by the Government to promote apparel manufacturing and its export in the country 
are:-  
 
(i)  Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for textiles for Man Made Fibre Fabrics & Apparel, 
and Technical Textiles has been launched in 2021-22. It is expected to attract investment of       
Rs. 19000 crore for manufacturing of notified product of the sector and will be able to provide 
employment opportunity for 7.5 lakh persons. 
(ii) PM Mega Integrated Textile Regions and Apparel (MITRAs) Parks Scheme to set up 7 Mega 
Textiles Manufacturing Parks in the country has also been launched in 2021-22. This will reduce 
logistics cost and will improve Competitiveness of Indian textile manufacturing. Once completed 
each park is expected to provide employment to 1 lakh persons directly and 2 lakh persons 
indirectly. 
(iii) In order to make textiles products cost competitive and adopting the principle of zero rated export, 
the Union Cabinet has given approval for continuation of Rebate of State and Central Taxes and 
Levies (RoSCTL) on exports of Apparel/Garments (Chapters-61 & 62) and Made-ups     
(Chapter
-63) till 31 st March 2024. The other textiles products (excluding Chapter 61, 62 and 63) 
which are not covered under the RoSCTL are eligible to avail the benefits, if any, under RoDTEP 
along with other products. 
(iv) Apart from this, the Government is also running Schemes viz. Amended Technology Up-
gradation Scheme (ATUFS), Integrated Processing Development Scheme (IPDS), National 
Technical Textile Mission (NTTM), etc. for holistic development of textile sector.

इसक े  अलावा , भारत  सरकार  द्वारा 22 नए  एसटीपीआई क ें द्रों को अनुमोकदत  ककया  गया है । 
इलेक्ट्ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्रालय ( एमईआईटीवाई) ने  इलेक्ट्ट्रॉननकी  क्षेत्र में ननवेश  
आकर्षषत करने  के  नलए  सामान्य सुनवधाओं और  साधनों  सनहत नवश्व स्तरीय बुननयादी  ढांचे  के  
ननमाचण  के  नलए  सहयोग प्रदान करने  के  नलए  अक्ट्टूबर, 2012 में इलेक्ट्ट्रॉननकी  नवननमाचण  क्ट्लस्टर

नलए  बंद कर  दी गई थी । इस योजना  के  तहत देश भर  के  15 राज्यों में 19 ग्रीनफीलड इलेक्ट्ट्रॉननकी

क्ट्लस्टर (ईएमसी 2.0) योजना  शुरू  की  है जो माचच , 2023 तक  आवेदन  प्राप्त करने  के  नलए  खुली  है

ग्रामीण इलाकों में कम इंटरनेट कनेक्‍ टविटी 
2618. श्रीमती गीता उर्च चन्‍द रप्रभा:    
  
क्या संचार  मंत्री यह बताने की कृपा करेंगे ककिः 
(क)  वततमान में देश के ग्रामीण इलाकों में इंटरनेट कनेक्क् ट ववटी का क ुल कवरेज ककतना है , तत् संबंधी ब् यौरा क् या 
है;  
(ख)  क् या यह सच है कक आज भी अधधकांश ग्रामीण इलाकों में लोग इंटरनेट सेवाओं से वंधचत हैं; और   
(ग)  सरकार द्वारा इंटरनेट कनेक्क् ट ववटी कवरेज बढाने के ललए क् या -क् या कदम उठाए जा रहे हैं? 
   
उत्तर 
संचार राज् य मंत्री  
(श्री देिुससंह चौहान)  
 
(क) और (ख) लाइसेंसधारी सेवा प्रदाताओं के द्वारा ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में वायरलेस मोबाइल और किक् ् ड वायरलाइन 
कनेक्शनों  के माध्यम से इंटरनेट/ब्रॉडबैंड क्नेक्क्टववटी प्रदान की जा रही है। द ूरसंचार सेवा प्रदाताओं और द ूरसंचार 
ववभाग की िील्ड इकाइयों के द्वारा उपलब्ध करवाए गए डाटा के अन ुसार अन ु
मान है कक देश में बसे ह ुए 
5,97,618 ग्रामों (वर्त 2011 की जनगणना के अन ुसार) में से 5,58,537 ग्रामों में मोबाइल वायरलेस ब्रॉडबैंड कवरेज 
उपलब् ध है।  
 
(ग) सरकार ने देश में इंटरनेट/ब्रॉडबैंड क्नेक्क्टववटी की कवरेज ब ढाने के ललए ननम्नललखखत कदम उठाए  हैं:  
 
(i) डडक्जटल संचार अवसंरचना के ववकास  को तेज करने , डडक्जटल अंतर को पाटने , डडक्जटल सशक्क्तकरण 
तथा समावेश को सुलभ बनाने तथा सभी को ब्रॉडबैंड की ककफ़ायती और सावतभौलमक पह ुुँच प्रदान करने 
के उद्देश्य के साथ राष्ट्रीय ब्रॉडबैंड लमशन को ददनांक 17 ददसंबर, 2019 को श ुरू ककया गया था।    
(ii) देश की सभी ग्राम पंचायतों और ग्रामों में उच्च गनत इंटरनेट/ब्रॉडबैंड क्नेक्क्टववटी प्रदान करने के इस 
प्रयास में भारतनेट पररयोजना की पररकल्पना की गई हैं।  
(iii) देश में इंटरनेट/ब्रॉडबैंड के प्रसार को बढाने के ललए प्रधानमंत्री वायर लेस  अलभगम नेटवकत इंटरफ़ े स 
(पीएम-वानी) फ्र े मवकत की शुरुआत की गई है।  
(iv) पूवोत्तर क्षेत्र (एनईआर) , वामपंथी उग्रवाद से प्रभाववत (एल डब् ल् यूई) क्षेत्रों, सीमावती क्षेत्रों, आकां क्षी क्जलों 
और द्वीपीय प्रदेशों सदहत देश के ग्रामीण और द ूर्थ क्षेत्रों में मोबाइल ब्रॉडबैंड सेवाओं को बढाने के 
ललए सावतभौलमक सेवा दानयत्व ननधध (य ूएसओएि) के अंतगतत ववलभन्न ्कीमों को कायातक्न्वत ककया  
गया है।

2619. श्री संजय राउत :  
क्या संचार मंत्री यह बताने की कृपा करेंगे ककिः 
 
(क)  क् या यह सच है कक कई विदेशी कंपननयों ने देश में अंतररक्ष उपग्रह के माध् यम से ब्रॉडबैंड 
सेिाएं शुरू करने की अन ुमनत लेने के ललए सरकार से संपकक ककया है ; और  
(ख ) यदद  हां, तो तत् संबंधी ब् यौरा क् या है और इस पर सरकार की  क् या प्रनतकिया है? 
 
उत्तर 
संचार राज् य मंत्री  
(श्री देिुलसंह चौहान)  
 
(क) एिं (ख) हाल ही में विदेशी उपग्रह प्रचालकों की सहभागगता िाली ननम् नललखखत भारतीय 
कंपननयों ने द ूरसंचार विभाग से संपकक ककया है और भारत में ब्रॉडबैंड सेिाओं सदहत सेटेलाइट 
आधाररत संचार सेिाएं उपलब् ध कराने के ललए  अपने  प्रस् ताि प्रस् तुत ककए हैं।  
 
क्र.सं. उस कंपनी का नाम जजसने द ूरसंचार विभाग से संपकच ककया है  
1 िन िेब इंडडया कम् युननकेशन प्राइिेट लललमटेड - द ूरसंचार विभाग से पहले  से प्राप् त नेशनल 
लॉ ंग डडस् टेंस (एनएलडी) प्रागधकार  के  साथ एकीक ृत- लाइसेंस के अंतगकत ग् लो बल मोबाइल 
पसकनल कम् युननकेशन बाय सैटेलाइट (जीएमपीसीएस) प्रागधकार जारी करने के ललए आिेदन 
प्राप् त हुआ। 
2 जजओ  सैटेलाइट कम् युननकेशन सविकसेज - एकीक ृत-लाइसेंस के अंतगकत जीएमपीसीएस प्रागधकार 
जारी करने के  ललए  आिेदन प्राप् त हुआ। 
3 मैससक ने ल् को लललमटेड -  प्रायोगगक लाइसेंस जारी करने के ललए आिेदन प्राप् त हुआ। 
4 मैससक स् टारललंक  सैटेलाइट  कम् युननकेशं स प्राइिेट लललमटेड- प्रायोगगक लाइसेंस जारी करने के 
ललए आिेदन प्राप् त हुआ।

i)  भारतीय  क ं लयूटर  अपातकालीन  प्रनतकिया दल  ( सीइअरटी -आन ) नडनजटल  प्रौद्योनगककयों के  
सुरनक्षत ईपयोग को  सुनननित  करने  हेतु ननयनमत  अधार  पर  नवीनतम साआबर खतरों  और  प्रनत-
ईपायों के  संबंध में ऄलटच  तथा परामशच  जारी  करता  है । सीइअरटी -आन  ने  डेटा सुरक्षा और  
धोखाधडी सम्बन्धी गनतनवनधयों को  कम  करने  हेतु संगठनों तथा ईपयोगकताचओं  के  नलए  68 
परामशच  जारी  ककए  हैं ।  
ii) ईपयोगकताचओं  हेतु ईनक े  डेस्कटॉप, मोबाआल /स्माटच फोन  को सुरनक्षत रखने  तथा क़िलशग हमलों  
को  रोकने की  कदशा में सुरक्षा युनियााँ प्रकानशत की  गइ हैं ।  
  
686

iii) सरकार ने  मुख्य सूचना  सुरक्षा ऄनधकाररयों  ( सीअइएसओ) हेतु अवेदन / अधारभूत संरचना  
तथा ऄनुपालन  हेतु ईनकी  प्रमुख भूनमकाओं  तथा ईत्तरदानयत्वों के  संबंध में कदशाननदेश  जारी  
ककए  हैं। 
iv) सीइअरटी -आन  ने  सूचना  सुरक्षा सवोत्तम कायचप्रणाली  के  कायाचन्वयन  का  सहयोग देने  तथा 
लेखा -परीक्षा करने  हेतु 96 सुरक्षा लेखा  परीक्षा संगठनों  को  सूचीबद्ध  ककया  है।  
v) सीइअरटी -आन  अइटी ऄवसंरचना  को  सुरनक्षत करने  तथा साआबर  हमलों  को  कम  करने  संबंधी 
सरकार  एवं महत्वपूणच क्षेत्र के  संगठनों  के  नेटवक च /नसस्टम प्रशासकों तथा मुख्य सूचना  सुरक्षा 
ऄनधकाररयों  (सीअइएसओ) हेतु ननयनमत  प्रनशक्षण कायचिम  अयोनजत करता  है। वषच 2020 और  
2021 के  दौरान , िमशः 708 और  5169 प्रनतभानगयों की  ईपनस्थनत सनहत 15 और  19 
प्रनशक्षण कायचिम  अयोनजत ककए  गए। 
vi) सीइअरटी -आन  साआबर  स्वच्छता  क ें द्र (बॉटनेट  सफाइ तथा मैलवेयर  नवश्लेषण क ें द्र) संचानलत  कर  
रहा  है। क ें द्र नागररकों  तथा संगठनों  हेतु दुभाचवनापूणच  कायचिमों  का  पता लगाने  और  ईन्हें हटाने  
की  कदशा में ननशुल्क  ईपकरण  ईपलब्ध करा  रहा  है। 
vii) सीइअरटी -आन  ने  वतचमान  तथा संभानवत साआबर सुरक्षा खतरों  के  संबंध में अवश्यक 
नस्थनतजन्य जागरूकता  सृजन  करने  हेतु राष्ट्रीय साआबर समन्वय क ें द्र (एनसीसीसी ) की  स्थापना 
की  है । एनसीसीसी  का  चरण-I चालू  है । 
viii) एमइअइटीवाइ सूचना  सुरक्षा जागरूकता  सृजन  करने  हेतु कायचिम  अयोनजत कर  रहा  है । 
सूचना  सुरक्षा के  संबंध में बच्चों , ऄनभभावकों तथा सामान्य ईपयोगकताचओं  हेतु नवनशष्ट पुस्तक ें, 
वीनडयो तथा ऑनलाआन  सामग्री नवकनसत  की  जाती हैं, नजन्हें "www.infosecawareness.in" 
और  " www.cyberswachhtakendra.gov.in" जैसे पोटचलों  के  माध्यम से प्रसाररत ककया  
जाता है।

# नोट: नडनजटल  भुगतान  मोड: भीम-यूपीआई, आईएमपीएस, एनएसीएच , एईपीएस , और  
एनईटीसी , डेनबट काडच , क्र े नडट काडच , एनईएफटी , आरटीजीएस , पीपीआई और  अन्य पर  नवचार  
ककया  गया ।  
* अनंनतम  डेटा ।  
स्रोत: भारतीय  ररजवच बैंक  (आरबीआई ), भारतीय  राष्ट्रीय भुगतान  ननगम ( एनपीसीआई) और  बैंक  
 
इलेक ् ‍ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्रालय (एमईआईटीवाई) द्वारा नडनजटल  भुगतान  को  बढावा 
देने  के  नलए  ननम्ननलनखत  प्रमुख कदम  उठाए गए हैं : 
 
i. देश में नडनजटल लेनदेनों का  और  अनधक  संवधचन  करने  हेतु एमईआईटीवाई द्वारा रुपे  डेनबट 
काडच  और  न् ‍यूनतम मूल्य वाले  भीम-यूपीआई लेनदेन  ( पी2एम) को  बढावा देने  के  नलए  
प्रोत्साहन योजना  शुरू  की  गई है । यह योजना  बैंकों  को  सुदृढ नडनजटल  भुगतान  
पाररनथथनतकी तंत्र बनाने , रुपे  डेनबट काडच  और  भीम-यूपीआई नडनजटल  लेनदेन को  बढावा 
देने , सभी क्षेत्रों और  आबादी के  क्षेत्रों और  इसक े साथ  ही देश में नडनजटल  भुगतान  को  और  
अनधक सुदृढ  करने  की  सुनवधा  प्रदान करती  है । 
  
689

ii. नडनजटल  भुगतान  को  तेजी से अपनाने  के  नलए  ग्राहक/व्यापारी व्यवहार को  बदलने  हेतु 
एमईआईटीवाई द्वारा कई  अन्य प्रोत्साहन/क ै शबैक  योजनाएं  शुरू  की  गईं। उनमें  से क ु छ 
व्यनियों और  व्यापाररयों के  नलए  भीम क ै शबैक  योजनाएँ , भीम आधार  व्यापारी प्रोत्साहन 
योजना , भीम‍– यूपीआई व्यापारी ऑन -बोर्डडग योजना  व्यापारी छ ू ट दर  ( एमडीआर ) 
प्रनतपूर्शत योजना  थीं।  
iii. एमईआईटीवाई ने  क ें द्रीय मंत्रालयों/नवभागों और  राज्यों/संघ राज्‍य क्षेत्रों को  भुगतान  
थवीक ृ नत के  बुननयादी  ढांचे  में सुधार  करने  के  नलए  परामशी  ननदेश  जारी  ककए  और  इस तरह  
नागररकों  को इंटरनेट  बैंककग , मोबाइल  बैंककग  और  मोबाइल  एनललक े शन  आकद जैसे नवनभन्न 
तरीकों  से भुगतान  करने  में सक्षम बनाया  । 
iv. एमईआईटीवाई ने ‍“ प्रधानमंत्री”‍ ग्रामीण नडनजटल  साक्षरता अनभयान  ( पीएमजीकदशा)”‍
नामक  योजना  को  ग्रामीण भारत  में नडनजटल  साक्षरता की शुरुआत  करने  के  नलए  शुरू  ककया  
।    
v. एमईआईटीवाई ने  सभी बैंकों  और  भुगतान  सेवा प्रदाताओं को  सुरनक्षत भुगतान  प्रणानलयों 
को  बढावा देने  और  सूचना  सुरक्षा जागरूकता  उत्पन्न करने  के  नलए  जागरूकता  अनभयान  
चलाने  की सलाह  दी । पोटचलों   "www.infosecawareness.in", 
www.cyberswachhtakendra.gov.in  के  माध्यम से सूचना  सामग्री का  प्रचार - प्रसार 
ककया  जाता है ।  
vi. भीम ऐप सनहत नडनजटल  भुगतान  को  बढावा देने  के  नलए  पूवोत्तर के  राजधानी  शहरों  में 
जागरूकता  अनभयान  चलाए  गए। एमईआईटीवाई ने  नडनजटल  भुगतान  को  बढावा देने  के  
नलए  समाचार  पत्र अनभयान , नडनजटल  नथएटर  अनभयान , एफएम रेनडयो  अनभयान  और  
जमाखोरी  अनभयान  भी चलाए  । 
vii. नागररकों  को नडनजटल  भुगतान  का  उपयोग करने  के  नलए  प्रोत्सानहत करने  हेतु प्रचार  के  
पारंपररक  माध्यमों के  साथ -साथ  सोशल  मीनडया ललेटफॉमच  जैसे आकनथमक साधनों  के  
माध्यम से नवनभन्न प्रचार  और  जागरूकता  अनभयान  शुरू  ककए  गए हैं। 
viii. सप्ताह भर  चलने  वाले  ' आजादी का  नडनजटल  महोत्सव ' के  भाग के  रूप  में, एमईआईटीवाई 
ने  ' नडनजटल  भुगतान  उत्सव ' के  माध्यम से भारत  की नडनजटल  भुगतान  यात्रा का  जश्न 
मनाया।  इस कदन   भारत  में नडनजटल  भुगतान  की  यात्रा और  उदय का  जश्न मनाया  गया और  
सरकार , बैंककग  क्षेत्र, कफनटेक  क ं पननयों  और  थटाटचअप के  अनधनायको   को  एक  साथ  लाया  
गया । नडनजटल भुगतान  को  बढावा देने  की  कदशा में नवत्त वषच 2019-20 और  नवत्त वषच 
2020-21 में प्राप्‍त की  गई उपलनधधयों  हेतु नवनभन्न श्रेनणयों में शीषच बैंकों  को  सम्माननत 
ककया  गया और  मान्यता दी गई । 
ix. एमईआईटीवाई ने  उपभोिा मामलें  के  नवभाग (डीओसीए) के  राष्ट्रीय उपभोिा हेल्पलाइन  
(एनसीएच ) ललेटफॉमच  के  साथ  इसका  उपयोग करने  के  नलए  उपभोिा मामले  मंत्रालय 
(एमओसीए) के  साथ  नडनजटल  भुगतान  नशकायतों  को  एकीक ृ त  ककया  है। सभी प्रमुख बैंक  
और  नवत्तीय सेवा संथथान  एनसीएच  ललेटफॉमच  पर  शानमल  ककए  गए हैं। ललेटफॉमच  लाइव  है 
और  नडनजटल भुगतान  संबंधी  नशकायतें  प्राप्त कर  रहा  है । 
x. नडनजटल  भुगतान  की  सुरक्षा और  संरक्षा सुनननित  करने  के  नलए , सरकार  और  भारतीय  
ररजवच  बैंक  (आरबीआई ) द्वारा नवनभन्न कदम  उठाए गए हैं ।

 क्या  आलेक ् ‍ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्री यह बताने की  क ृ पा करेंगे  कक :

(ग) आन  ननयमों  के  भाग-II के  ऄंतगचत ककतनी  नशकायतें  प्राप्‍त हुइ हैं और  ऄब तक  ईन  पर  क् ‍या 
कारचवाइ  की  गइ है; और  
 
(घ) क् ‍या नए ननयम के  भाग III में स्‍तर  I,II और  III के  रूप  में ननर्ददष्‍ट ककए  गए व्‍यनि /पदों पर

आलेक ् ‍ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना प्रौद्योनगकी राज्य मंत्री (श्री राजीव  चंद्रशेखर)  
 
(क ): भारत  में खुला, सुरनित  और  भरोसेमंद  और  जवाबदेह आंटरनेट  सुनननित  करने  हेतु सरकारी

द्वारा सम्यक तत्परता का  पालन  करने  का  प्रावधान है।

 क्या  इलेक ् ‍ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्री यह बताने की  क ृ पा करेंगे  कक :

(क ): जी, हां । भारत  सरकार  ने  देश में इलेक्ट्रॉननकी  नवननमाचण  क्षेत्र को  व्यापक और  सुदृढ़ करने  और

नवननमाचण  क्लस्टर  (ईएमसी 2.0) योजना  शुरू  की , ताकक प्रमुख इलेक्ट्रॉननकी  नवननमाचताओं  को  ऐसे

आकर्षषत करने  के  नलए बुननयादी  ढांचा  सहायता प्रदान की  जा सक े ।

2663.   श्रीमती शाांता क्षत्री:  
 क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मंत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे लक:

करती है ;

(ग)  लवशेर्कर पलिमी बंगाल राज् य सलहत प्रगलत का राज् य-वार और वर्च -वार ब् यौरा क् या है?    
 
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री प्रहलाद कसांह पटेल) 
 
(ि): जी हां ।  
(ख):  खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय (एमओएफपीआई) देश में सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यमों क े  
उन्नयन क े  ललए लवत्तीय, तकनीकी और व्यावसालयक सहायता प्रदान करने क े ललए क ें द्र प्रायोलजत 
"प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यम उन्नयन (पीएमएफएमई) योजना" कायाचन्वित कर रहा है। यह 
योजना 10,000 करोड़ रुपये क े  पररव्यय क े  साथ वर्च 2020-21 से 2024-25 तक पांर् वर्च की अवलध 
क े  ललए प्रर्ालनरत है।  
यह योजना इनपुट की खरीद , सामान्य सेवाओं का लाभ उठाने और उत्पादों क े  लवपणन क े  
मामले में पैमाने का लाभ उठाने क े  ललए एक लजला एक उत्पाद (ओडीओपी) दृलिकोण अपनाती है। 
योजना क े  ललए ओडीओपी मूल्य श्ृंखला लवकास और समथचन अवसंरर्ना क े  संरेखण क े  ललए फ्र े मवक च 
प्रदान करता है। 
इस योजना में व्यन्विगत सूक्ष्म उद्यमों, लकसान उत्पादक संगठनों (एफपीओ) / स्वयं सहायता 
समूहों (एसएर्जी) / उत्पादक सहकारी सलमलतयों को लनम्नललन्वखत सहायता की पररकल्पना की गई है:

ललंक्ड पूंजी सन्विडी लजसकी अलधकतम सीमा 10 लाख रुपये प्रलत यूलनट है; 
ii.  एफपीओ / एसएचजी / उत्पादि सहिारी सकमकतयोां िो समर्थन: क्लस्टरों और समूहों

छ ं टाई, ग्रेलडंग, भंडारण , सामान्य प्रसंस्करण, पैक े लजंग, लवपणन, परीक्षण आलद क े  ललए 35% की दर से

2664. श्री एम.वी. श्रेयम् स ि ु मार:  
 क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मंत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा कर ें गे लक:  
(ि)  क् या लिलभन् न हबचल खाद्य उत् पादों को बढािा देने क े  ललए नए खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्योगों 
(एफपीआई) की स् थापना लकए जाने का कोई प्रस् ताि है;  
(ख)  यलद हां, तो तत् संबंधी ब् यौरा क् या है; और    
(ग)  क े रल सलहत लकन -लकन स् थानों पर ऐसे उद्योगों की स् थापना करने पर लिर्ार लकया जा रहा है ?    
 
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री प्रहलाद कसांह पटेल) 
 
(ि) से (ग):  खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय स्वयं खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग स्थालपत नही ं करता है। 
तथालप यह प्रधान मंत्री लकसान संपदा योजना (पीएमक े एसिाई) की घटक योजनाओं क े  तहत हबचल 
खाद्य उत्पादों से संबंलधत उद्योगों सलहत ऐसे उद्योगों की स्थापना को प्रोत्सालहत करता है। मंत्रालय 
क े रल सलहत देश भर में ऐसे उद्योग स्थालपत करने क े  ललए अनुदान सहायता क े  रूप में क्र े लिट ललंक्ि 
लित्तीय सहायता (प ंजीगत सब्सििी) प्रदान करता है। समय-समय पर जारी अलभरुलर् की अलभव्यब्सि 
(ईओआई) क े  आधार पर सहायता क े  ललए पररयोजनाओं का र्यन लकया जाता है।

2665.  सुश्री इांदु बािा गोस् वामी:  
 क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मंत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे लक:  
(ि)  वर्च 2018-20 की अवलि क े  ललए प्रिानमंत्री लकसान सम् पदा योजना (पीएमक े एसवाई) क े  
अंतगचत लकतनी िरालि आवंलित की गई है;  
(ख)  प्रिानमंत्री लकसान सम् पदा योजना क े  अंतगचत र्लाई जा रही घिक योजनाओं का ब् यौरा क् या है;   
(ग)  सरकार द्वारा इस योजना क े  अंतगचत लकस प्रकार का मॉडल तैयार लकया गया है , लहमार्ल 
प्रदेि सलहत तत् संबंिी राज् य-वार ब् यौरा क् या है?    
 
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री प्रहिाद कसांह पिेि) 
 
(ि) से (ग): खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय (एमओएफपीआई) क ें द्रीय क्षेत्र की अंब्रेला योजना - 
प्रिानमंत्री लकसान संपदा योजना (पीएमक े एसवाई) को लहमार्ल प्रदेि सलहत देि भर में घिक 
योजनाओं अर्ाचत (i) मेगा फ ू ड पाक च  (एमएफपी) ); (ii) एकीक ृ त िीत श्ृंखला और मूल्यविचन 
अवसंरर्ना (सीसी); (iii) खाद्य प्रसंस्करण और परररक्षण क्षमता (सीईएफपीपीसी) सृजन/ 
लवस्तार; (iv) क ृ लर्-प्रसंस्करण क्लस्टर अवसंरर्ना (एपीसी); (v) बैकवडच और फॉरवडच 
ललंक े ज सृजन (सीबीएफएल) ; (vi) खाद्य सुरक्षा और गुणवत्ता आश्वासन अवसंरर्ना (एफिीएल); 
(vii) मानव संसािन और संस्र्ान (एर् आरआई); और ( viii) ऑपरेिन ग्रीन्स (ओजी) क े  
सार् कायाचन्वित कर रहा है। मंत्रालय ने एमएफपी, सीबीएफएल , एफिीएल क े  एर्एसीसीपी घिक 
और एर्आरआई क े  कौिल लवकास घिक क े  तहत लकसी भी नई पररयोजना को आगे अनमोदन नहीं 
देने का लनणचय ललया है।  
पीएमक े एसवाई फामच गेि से खुदरा आउिलेि तक क ु िल आपूलतच श्ृंखला प्रबंिन तर्ा छोिे 
और मध्यम स्तर क े  खाद्य उत्पाद लनमाचण यूलनिों में अवसंरर्ना लनमाचण क े  ललए पूंजी लनवेि को बढावा 
देता है। इसकी घिक योजनाओं क े  तहत पात्र आवेदकों अर्ाचत व्यन्वियों, लकसानों, लकसान 
उत्पादक संगठनों (एफपीओ), उद्यलमयों, सहकारी सलमलतयों , सलमलतयों, स्वयं सहायता समूहों 
(एसएर्जी), लनजी क ं पलनयों और क ें द्र / राज्य सावचजलनक क्षेत्र क े  उपक्रमों आलद का र्यन समय-
समय पर जारी अलभरुलर् की अलभव्यन्वि (ईओआई) क े  आिार पर अनुदान सहायता क े  रूप में क्र े लडि 
ललंक्ड क ै लपिल सन्विडी प्रदान की जाती है।  
पीएमक े एसवाई की घिक योजनाओं क े  तहत 2018-19, 2019-20 और 2020 -21 में लकए 
गए बजिीय आवंिन और उपयोग की गई लनलि अनुबंि में दी गई है।

खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय 
राज्य सभा 
अताराांकित प्रश्न सां. 2666 
25 मार्च, 2022 को उत्तर देने क े  ललए 
 
प्रधानमांत्री किसान सम्पदा योजना 
2666. डॉ. कििास महात्मे:  
 
 क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे लक:  
(ि)  समावेशी प्रधानमंत्री लकसान सम्पदा योजना (पीएमक े एसवाई) से लकतने लकसानों को प्रत्यक्ष 
और अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से लाभ प्राप्त हुआ है;  
(ख)  इस समावेशी योजना क े  अंतगचत कायाचन्वित की जा रही कई योजनाओं क े  तहत राज्य-वार और 
वर्च-वार लकतने-लकतने फ ू ड पाक च , कोल्ड र्ेन इन्फ्रास्ट् रक्चर और क्लस्ट्र बनाए गए हैं; और  
(ग)   क्या सरकार ने इस योजना क े  प्रभाव का आकलन करने क े  ललए कोई अध्ययन/सवेक्षण 
कराया है, यलद हााँ, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है?    
 
उत्तर 
 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री प्रहलाद कसांह पटेल) 
 
(ि): यह अनुमान है लक प्रधानमंत्री लकसान संपदा योजना (पीएमक े एसवाई) से संबंलधत घटक 
योजनाओं की शुरुआत क े  बाद से 29 लाख से अलधक लकसान लाभान्वित हुए हैं।  
(ख): लवलभन्न राज्यों/संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों में न्वथित पीएमक े एसवाई क े  तहत मेगा फ ू ड पाकों, एकीक ृ त शीत 
श्ृंखला पररयोजनाओं और क ृलर् प्रसंस्करण क्लस्ट्रों की संख्या अनुबांध में दी गई है।  
(ग):  जी हााँ, मंत्रालय ने पीएमक े एसवाई की संगत घटक योजनाओं क े  ललए मूल्ांकन अध्ययन लकया 
है। इन अध्ययनों से लनष्कर्च लनकाला है लक घटक योजनाओं ने लकसानों को पयाचप्त लाभ क े  साि बडे 
पैमाने पर अपने उद्देश्ों को प्राप्त लकया है। वर्च 2020 में मेससच नाबाडच क ं सल्टेंसी लललमटेड द्वारा 
आयोलजत पीएमक े एसवाई क े  तहत एकीक ृ त शीत श्ृंखला और मूल् वधचन अवसंरर्ना योजना क े  
मूल्ांकन अध्ययन से अनुमान लगाया है लक योजना क े  तहत क ै लिव पररयोजनाओं क े  पररणामस्वरूप 
फामच-गेट की कीमतों में 12.38% की वृन्वि हुई है और प्रत्येक पररयोजना औसतन 9500 से अलधक 
लकसानों को लाभ होने का अनुमान है।

2667.  श्री जी.सी. चन्द्रशेखर:  
 क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा कर ें गे लक:  
(ि)  लिगत पांर् िर्षों क े  दौरान मंत्रालय द्वारा कनाचटक में खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योगों (एफपीआई) क े  
ललए िर्षच-िार लकस प्रकार की लित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की गई है; और  
(ख)  कनाचटक में संगलित और असंगलित दोनों क्षेत्रों में स्थालपत लकए गए खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यमों 
का ब्यौरा क्या है?    
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री प्रहलाद कसांह पटेल) 
 
(ि): खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय (एमओएफपीआई) कनाचटक सलहत दे श भर में प्रधान मंत्री 
लकसान संपदा योजना (पीएमक े एसिाई) की घटक योजनाओं क े  तहत खाद्य प्रसंस्करण/परररक्ष ण 
उद्योगों की स्थापना क े  ललए उद्यलमयों को अनुदान सहायता क े  रूप में क्र े लिट ललंक्ि लित्तीय सहायता 
(प ंजीगत सब्सििी) प्रदान करता है। कनाचटक में प्रदान की गई लित्तीय सहायता क े  साथ पीएमक े एसिाई 
क े  तहत अनुमोलदत खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योगों का लििरण अर्ुबांध- 1 में लदया गया है।  
एमओएफपीआई देश भर में स क्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यमों की स्थापना/उन्नयन क े  ललए लित्तीय, 
तकनीकी और व्यािसालयक सहायता प्रदान करने क े  ललए क ें द्र प्रायोलजत "प्रधानमंत्री स क्ष्म खाद्य 
प्रसंस्करण उद्यम उन्नयन (पीएमएफएमई) योजना" भी कायाचब्सित कर रहा  है। योजना क े  तहत 
कनाचटक को जारी की गई िर्षचिार लनलध अर्ुबांध-2 में दी गई है।  
(ख):  उद्योग 2018-19 क े  िालर्षचक सिेक्षण क े  अनुसार कनाचटक में खाद्य उत्पादों और पेय पदाथों क े  
लनमाचण में लगी पंजीक ृ त य लनटों की संख्या 2,343 है और  एनएसएस क े  73िें दौर (जुलाई 2015 - ज न 
2016) क े  अनुसार  राज्य में खाद्य उत्पादों और पेय पदाथों का लनमाचण करने िाले 1 ,27,458 अलनगलमत 
उद्यम हैं।

मीट किर्ाात िीकत 
2668.   श्री जी.सी. चन्द्रशेखर:  
 क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे लक:  
(ि)  सरकार की मौजूदा मी ट लनयाचत नीलत का ब्यौरा क्या है;  
(ख)  वर्च 2017 से अब तक देश से लनयाचत लकए गए लवलभन्न प्रकार क े  मीट और मीट उत्पादों की 
क ु ल मात्रा और मूल्य का मद-वार, देश -वार और कम्पनी-वार ब्यौरा क्या है;   
(ग)  यलद ऐसा डाटा उपलब्ध नहीं है, तो ऐसी जानकारी नहीं रखे जाने क े  क्या कारण हैं; और  
(घ) वर्च 2017 से अब तक घरेलू उपयोग और लनयाचत क े  उद्देश्य से उत्पालदत लवलभन्न प्रकार क े  मीट 
का राज्य-वार, वर्च-वार और मद -वार ब्यौरा क्या है?    
 
उत्तर 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री प्रहलाद कसांह पटेल) 
 
(ि) से ( ग): मांस और मांस उत्पादों क े  लनयाचत की देखभाल वालणज्य लवभाग क े  अंतगचत क ृ लर् और 
प्रसंस्क ृ त खाद्य उत्पाद लनयाचत लवकास एजेंसी (एपीडा) द्वारा की जाती है। एपीडा द्वारा दी गई सूर्ना क े  
अनुसार  कोई लवलशष्ट मांस लनयाचत नीलत नहीं है। तथालप मांस और मांस उत्पादों क े  लनयाचत क े  ललए 
लवलशष्ट आवश्यकता भारत सरकार की लवदेश व्यापार नीलत क े  अध्याय 2 की अनुसूर्ी 2 (लनयाचत नीलत) 
-भारतीय व्यापार वगीकरण (सामंजस्यपूणच प्रणाली) में दी गई है। 
 
एपीडा द्वारा प्रस्तुत आंकडों क े  अनुसार वर्च 2016-17 से 2021 -22 (अप्रैल-जनवरी) तक मात्रा और 
मूल्य क े  संदभच में मांस और मांस उत्पादों क े  लनयाचत का मद-वार लववरण अिुबांध-1 में लदया गया है  
और वर्च 2020-21 में मांस और मांस उत्पादों क े  लनयाचत का देश-वार लववरण अिुबांध-2 में लदया गया 
है। तथालप लवदेश व्यापार महालनदेशालय (डीजीएफटी) की डाटा प्रसार नीलत क े  वालणज्यज्यक गोपनीयता 
खंड क े  कारण क ं पनी-वार सूर्ना का प्रसार नहीं लकया जाता है। 
 
(घ): लवलभन्न प्रकार क े  मांस क े  उत्पादन पर डाटा पशुपालन और डेयरी लवभाग द्वारा रखा जाता है। 
लवभाग द्वारा उपलब्ध कराए गए आंकडों क े  अनुसार वर्च 2016-17 से 2020-21 तक मांस उत्पादन 
का राज्यवार लववरण अिुबांध-3 में लदया गया है और  वर्च 2016-17 से 2019-20 तक मांस उत्पादन 
का प्रजालत-वार लववरण अिुबांध-4 में लदया गया है।

 क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मंत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे लक:

ब् यौरा क् या है;   
(ख)  खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्योगों की संवृद्धि में सरकार की क् या भूलमका है;     
(ग)  खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्योंगों (एफपीआई) में प्रमुख योगदान देने वाली सामलियों का ब् यौरा क् या है; और  
(घ) आंध्र प्रदेश राज् य में एफपीआई की संवृद्धि की द्धस्िलत क् या है?     
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री प्रहलाद कसांह पटेल) 
 
(ि): खाद्य प्रसंस्करण क्षेत्र में सकल मूल् य संवधचन (जीवीए) 2014-15 में 1.34 लाख करोड़ रुपए से 
बढ़कर 2019-20 में 2.24 लाख करोड़ रुपए हो गया है , जो 10. 82% की र्क्रवृद्धि वालषचक वृद्धि दर 
(सीएजीआर) पर है ।  
(ख): खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्योग मंत्रालय प्रधानमंत्री लकसान संपदा योजना (पीएमक े एसवाई) जैसी लवलभन् न 
योजनाओं को कायाच द्धित करक े  खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्योगों क े  लवकास में योगदान देता है जो आधुलनक 
फसलोत् तर अवसंरर्ना और मूल् यवधचन सृजन क े  माध् यम से खाद्य प्रसंस् करण क्षेत्र की समि वृद्धि और 
लवकास क े  ललए एक व् यापक कायचक्रम है । मंत्रालय आत् मलनभचर भारत अलभयान क े  लहस् से के रूप में दो नई 
योजनाओं को भी लागू कर रहा है ।  
(i) एक लजला एक उत् पाद (ओडीओपी) दृलिकोण पर दो लाख सूक्ष् म खाद्य प्रसंस् करण यूलनटों क े  
उन् नयन/स् िापना क े  ललए लवत् तीय, तकनीकी और व् यावसालयक सहायता प्रदान करने क े  लक्ष् य क े  
साि प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष् म खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्यम उन् नयन (पीएमएफएमई) योजना ।  
(ii) लवलनमाचण प्रलतस् पधाचत् मकता और लनयाचत को बढ़ावा देने और वैलिक खाद्य लनमाचण र्ैंलपयन बनाने क े  
ललए उत् पादन ललंक् ड प्रोत् साहन (पीएलआई) योजना ।  
(ग): वषच 2019-20 क े  दौरान खाद्य प्रसंस् करण क्षेत्र में मूल् यवधचन में योगदान करने वाले लनम् नललद्धखत 
प्रसंस् क ृत खाद्य पदािों में शालमल हैं (i) बेकरी उत् पादों का लनमाचण, र्ीनी और र्ीनी कन् फ ेक् शनरी, र्ॉकलेट 
और कोको उत् पाद, तैयार भोजन और व् यंजन, र्ाय और कॉफी का प्रसंस् करण और सद्धिश्रण; खाद्य मेवा,

(घ): सांद्धिकी और कायचक्रम कायाचन् वयन मंत्रालय द्वारा जारी उद्योगों क े  वालषचक सवेक्षण क े  अनुसार,

2671.   सुश्री सरोज पाण्डेय:  
 क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मांत्री यह बताने की कृपा करेंगे लक:  
(ि)  क्या सरकार ने लकसानों के उत्पादों का उनके ग्राम या आवास क्षेत्र में ही प्रसंस्करण करने और 
उनकी लबक्री करने के ललए कोई योजना बनायी है; और  
(ख)  यलद हां, तो इस योजना का स्वरूप क्या है, यलद नहीं, तो क्या सरकार ऐसी कोई योजना बनाएगी?    
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री प्रहिाद कसांह पटेि) 
 
(ि) और (ख): खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय (एमओएफपीआई) वर्च 2016-17 से केंद्रीय क्षेत्र की 
एक अम्ब्रेला योजना- प्रधान मंत्री लकसान संपदा योजना (पीएमकेएसवाई) कायाचन्वित कर रहा है। अपनी 
घटक योजनाओं के तहत यह अन्य बातों के साथ-साथ प्राथलमक प्रसंस्करण सुलवधाओं, संग्रह केंद्रों आलद 
जैसे कृलर् स्तरीय अवसंरर्ना के साथ खाद्य प्रसंस्करण /परररक्षण उद्योगों की स्थापना के ललए अनुदान 
सहायता प्रदान करता है। एमओएफपीआई वर्च 2020-21 से 2024-25 तक पांर् वर्च की अवलध के ललए 
10,000 करोड़ रुपये के पररव्यय के साथ केंद्र प्रायोलजत "प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यम उन्नयन 
(पीएमएफएमई) योजना" भी कायाचन्वित कर रहा है। पीएमएफएमई योजना स्वयं सहायता समूहों 
(एसएर्जी)/लकसान उत्पादक संगठनों (एफपीओ)/सहकाररता को सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण यूलनटों की 
स्थापना/उन्नयन, एसएर्जी को प्रारंलभक पूंजी, सामान्य अवसंरर्ना, लवपणन और ब्ांल ंग समथचन आलद 
के ललए सहायता प्रदान करती है। ये योजनाएं लकसानों को अपने उत्पाद को खेत के आसपास के क्षेत्र में 
प्रसंस्करण / बेर्ने में सहायता करती हैं।

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF PETROLEUM & NATURAL GAS 
RAJYA SABHA 
STARRED QUESTION NO. *256 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 28.03.2022 
 
APM for CNG and LNG 
 
*256. SHRI JOSE K. MANI:  
 
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government has the data regarding the number of LNG stations set up in the country 
in the last two years;   
 
(b) if so, the details thereof; 
 
(c)whether Government has any plans to come up with an Administered Price Mechanism 
(APM) for both CNG and LNG to ensure firm prices;  
 
(d) if so, the details thereof; 
 
(e) whether Government has any plans to allow a lower rate of GST for entities like State 
Transport Understandings (STUs) through their consumer fuel outlets; and 
 
(f) whether Government is exploring possibilities of direct bulk import of LNG/CNG for the 
consumption of STUs? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS  
(SHRI HARDEEP SINGH PURI) 
 
 
(a) to (f): A statement is laid on the Table of the House.

STATEMENT REFERRED IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (f) OF THE RAJYA SABHA 
STARRED QUESTION NO. *256 ASKED BY SHRI JOSE K. MANI TO BE ANSWERED

(a) and (b)  During last two years, 4 LNG stations have been set up across the country by Public 
Sector Undertakings and a Private Entity. GAIL has set up two LNG stations at Cuttack and 
Mandideep and Petronet LNG Limited has set up one LNG station at Kochi. One LNG station in 
the private sector has been set up at Nagpur, Maharashtra. 
(c) to (d) No, Sir. 
(e) Petroleum products namely, petroleum crude, high speed diesel, motor spirit (commonly 
known as petrol), natural gas (which includes CNG and LNG) and aviation turbine fuel (ATF) 
are outside the ambit of GST. 
(f) No, Sir. LNG imports are under open general licensing and any entity can directly import the 
same.

SHRI JOSE K. MANI: Sir, this question is very important in the context of the fact that 
the Leader of the Opposition has requested for a Short Duration Discussion on price 
rise, especially the rise in the prices of petroleum products.  My first supplementary 
question is this. State Transport Undertakings, STUs, are transporting passengers at 
the lowest fares; STUs convert many private vehicle users to use STUs and free the 
road space. When the Government of India promotes conversion from private to 
public transport, why are the State Transport Undertakings charged Rs.22 per litre of 
diesel extra as bulk users?  
 
MR. DEPUTY CHAIRMAN: Please be brief.  
 
SHRI JOSE K. MANI : Sir, I am putting my question. The same STUs can fill diesel at 
any public petrol bunk without bulk user fee on cash and carry basis.  My question to 
the Minister is: What is the rational for this extra bulk user fee of Rs.22 per litre of 
diesel to STUs like all the State Transport Corporations, especially Kerala State Road 
Transport Corporation?  
 
MR. DEPUTY CHAIRMAN :  Mr. Jose Mani, I would request you that if you take this 
much time, then, others will not get opportunity.  Please be brief in your questions.   
 
SHRI HARDEEP SINGH PURI : Sir, I want to thank the hon. Member. This question 
relates to LNG and CNG but the question which he has asked in the supplementary 
relates to the price of diesel.  Through you, Sir, let me just inform the House that there 
were two broad processees, State Public Transport providers, to which the hon. 
Member has referred, and some other State Enterprises, which were being supplied 
diesel at wholesale rates. By wholesale rates, I mean, rates which did not factor in 
dealer commission, etc. because they were going to those users directly.  What 
happened, in the aftermath of the pandemic and the military action which is taking 
place in one part of the world, is that global prices went haywire.  In the process, I 
should say, there were wide fluctuations.  As a result, the supplies to wholesalers 
somehow became more expensive than the supplies to the retail points.   So, what 
happened is that a lot of people who were getting discounted diesel started coming 
and queuing up in retail outlets.  I am told that this is a market mechanism functioning 
issue which should resolve itself very soon, as soon as there is stability and one 
knows which way the prices are going.  But the idea for anyone is not to charge the 
wholesalers more than the retailers.

SHRI JOSE K. MANI : Sir, I would make my second supplementary short.  My direct 
question is: Does the Government have any plans to propose STUs to convert any 
stipulated percentage of their existing fleet? Is there any additional subsidy proposed 
to State Transport Undertakings for purchase of new LNG/CNG vehicles?  
 
SHRI HARDEEP SINGH PURI : Sir, Liquefied National Gas to which the hon. Member 
is referring to is typically a natural gas cooled to a liquid state at about -260 degrees 
Fahrenheit or -162 degrees Celsius.  Sir, LNG is entirely outside the purview of any 
Governmental control. LNG is imported by the private sector directly for use in 
industry.  The Government has encouraged the establishment of what are called LNG 
dispensing stations. There are four of these including one at Kochi in Kerala -- one 
where Liquefied Natural Gas will go straight into heavy duty public transport 
providers.  
Now, out of the four LNG stations, which are dispensing stations that are available in 
the country, two of them are in a position to start dispensing LNG.  We had received 
a letter from the Government of Kerala, of which I have a copy, sometimes in the 
month of August 2021, where they told us that they were proposing to convert 400 
State transport buses into 'use for LNG'.  We have encouraged that.  We have, in 
fact, said that this is a classic case of the chicken and the egg.  The arrangements for 
supply of LNG are there.  Once the vehicles, which can use them, are available, I am 
sure they would start taking the LNG from the dispensing station.   
 
MR. DEPUTY CHAIRMAN:  Please be brief. 
 
SHRI HARDEEP SINGH PURI: What happens is that the LNG is normally transported 
in cryogenic cylinders.  We are quite happy that another station in Gujarat is actually 
dispensing about 70 kilos in a day. 
 
DR. FAUZIA KHAN:  Sir, according to a recent study, which was made by the Council 
on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW), 70 per cent of Indian households use 
Liquefied Petroleum Gas as their primary cooking fuel but 85 per cent have got 
connections.  So, there is a gap of 15 per cent.  Why is this 15 per cent not using 
that?  The consumer subsidy, which was stopped during the Covid-19 pandemic, 
after rise of Rs.50 in the price, would you reconsider starting of that subsidy?   
 
SHRI HARDEEP SINGH PURI:  Sir, I want to thank the hon. Member. The reference is 
to the extent to which our population and geographical area are being covered by 
7

CGD. I want to inform the hon. Member that we started this process many, many 
years ago. The 11 th round of bidding is going on currently. After the 11 th and 11- A 
round are complete, we would have over 8 8 per cent of our land area and 98 per cent 
of our population complete so that piped cooking gas can be delivered to 
households. But after the award during the bidding, it typically takes a certain number 
of years.  The only population, which would be left outside, would be those areas in 
the North East and some in Jammu and Kashmir where the physical ability to reach 
the households is a little difficult because they are widely disbursed. Typically, the 
cooking gas, which comes through the pipe, is cheaper and more consumer-friendly 
than that which is distributed through cylinders. 
 The hon. Member asked why the subsidy was stopped.  I would like to inform 
the hon. Member that through the Ujjwala scheme, those who had received the 
Ujjwala benefits earlier, they were given free cylinders during the pandemic. Today, 
we have a situation where the total number of gas connections, which stood at 14 
crores in 2014, has gone up to 30 crores.  This is an ongoing process where through 
the CGD, we would be trying to cover the entire population.  So, this is work in 
progress.   
    
SHRI V. VIJAYASAI REDDY:  Sir, is it true that the Centre is going to set up 1,000

these LNG stations?   
 
SHRI HARDEEP SINGH PURI:  Sir, I want to thank the hon. Member. We have a 
roadmap but this is a roadmap which contains only proposal and the idea is to set-up 
one thousand of these along the major highways, etc. It is because, typically, 
Liquefied Natural Gas, by virtue of direct dispensing from the dispensing station, can 
go into heavy duty vehicles which will ply on those, and a certain procedure also for 
setting up is under consideration. I would be happy to share with the hon. Member 
the specifics. We have also disseminated some of this in the Press that we are setting 
up the first 50 LNG fuelling stations, overall one thousand, in the next few years. I will 
be happy to share with him as to what it will take because it will require investment 
both in terms of establishment of the centres and making them functional.
